channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Police close down house in village cul-de-sac after antisocial incidents
item.description: A house in a Norfolk village has been closed by police after persistent issues with antisocial behaviour.

item.title: Food Enterprise Park to double in size after launching ambitious second phase
item.description: The Food Enterprise Park (FEP) near Norwich has launched its second phase as it seeks to help more innovative food and drink firms add value to Norfolk's farm produce.

item.title: First look inside city's new smokehouse in the Lanes
item.description: Dom Gregory and Jimmy Tully are opening a new smokehouse in Bridewell Alley. The pair took on the lease from Jeff Taylor, owner of The Bun Exchange.

item.title: Man charged with raft of offences after police motorcyclist hurt in roadside incident
item.description: A man has been charged with a string of offences after a police motorcyclist was hurt during an incident in Walton Highway, Norfolk, last month.

item.title: UEA student's cause of death revealed to court
item.description: An inquest into the death of a former UEA student stabbed to death at Somerleyton House in Norwich has been suspended.

item.title: Police launch search after woman, 79, vanishes from her home
item.description: Police are appealing for help to trace a 79-year-old woman who is missing from Norwich.

item.title: Village pub reduces opening hours to stay afloat through 'economic storm'
item.description: The landlords of the White Horse in South Lopham, Norfolk, have announced plans to reduce its opening hours to stay afloat in the face of huge financial pressures.

item.title: Fears pub's parking problems will 'only get worse' after revamp decision
item.description: Neighbours living near the Whiffler in Hellesdon say the decision to approve revamp plans for the pub will only worsen traffic congestion in the area.

item.title: Bus shelter protest sees bailiff and police turning up and booing accusations made
item.description: The battle of the Sheringham bus shelter took an amazing turn today as a bailiff and police turned up.

item.title: Bizarre 'bin lid' fish found dead on Norfolk beach
item.description: An unusual fish often likened to a bin lid because of its size and shape has been found dead on a Norfolk beach.
